open_move_resource.original_source:
def open_move_resource(self, form: str, resource_id: int, member: str, card_index: int | None = None):
    """Go to the original ALMT whose ID this Koma actually references."""
    if not self.root_data or not member or not member.endswith('.amt'):
        return False
    stem = member[:-4]
    valid = (stem == form and form in roster.BATTLE_IDS) or (
        form in roster.SUPPORT_IDS and stem in (f'{form}_2', f'{form}_3'))
    if not valid:
        self.status.set(f'Unverified move source: {form} / {member}')
        return False
    archive = join('chr/ChrArc.aar', f'chr/{stem}.aar')
    target = join(archive, member)
    if not self.root_data.exists(target):
        self.status.set(f'Missing ALMT: {target}')
        return False
    if self.almt_path != target and not self.confirm_discard():
        return False
    if self.container != archive:
        self.select_container(archive, form)
    if self.almt_path != target:
        self.almt_combo.set(member)
        self.load_almt(member)
    if not self.almt:
        return False
    found = next((i for i, m in enumerate(self.almt.moves) if m.id == resource_id), None)
    if found is None:
        self.status.set(f'Missing move {hx(resource_id)} in {target}')
        return False
    # The same battle ALMT move can be played from several deployed Koma.
    # Resolve NoteTrack 0x0402 through the explicitly chosen Koma, or the
    # size-specific Special A/B source link. Never guess a size for a
    # common/unnamed action without an associated card.
    idx = self.roster_browser.index
    matched_card = None
    if idx is not None:
        source_cards = []
        if card_index is not None:
            source_cards.append(card_index)
        elif self._sound_koma_card is not None:
            source_cards.append(self._sound_koma_card)
        for number in source_cards:
            if not 0 <= number < len(idx.cards.cards):
                continue
            candidate = idx.cards.cards[number]
            if any(v.resource_id == resource_id and v.almt_member == member
                   for v in idx.moves.card_moves(candidate)):
                matched_card = candidate
                break
        # Offset 0x29..0x32 encodes the 4..8 battle-Koma size in ROM.
        # Even when several cards use the same size, their sound bank is
        # identical (chr_b.bin +0x32 + 2*(size-4)).
        off = resource_id & 0xff
        if matched_card is None and form in roster.BATTLE_IDS and 0x29 <= off <= 0x32:
            size = 4 + (off - 0x29) // 2
            matched_card = next(
                (c for c in idx.by_form.get(form, ())
                 if c.size == size and
                 any(v.resource_id == resource_id and v.almt_member == member
                     for v in idx.moves.card_moves(c))),
                None)
    self._sound_koma_card = matched_card.index if matched_card is not None else None
    self.sound_form.set(f'{matched_card.size}-cell' if
                        matched_card is not None and form in roster.BATTLE_IDS else 'Auto')
    self.show_workspace('animation')
    self.roster_browser.select_move(form, resource_id, member)
    if self.move_filter.get():
        self.move_filter.set('')
    self.populate_moves(select=found)
    self.status.set(f'Koma source: {form} / {member} / {hx(resource_id)}')
    return True

_battle_base_table.original_source:
def _battle_base_table(self) -> bool:
    """True for a battle character's base move table (chr/<id>.aar|<id>.amt), the
    only table the input selector 0x021712B8 indexes."""
    if not self.almt_path:
        return False
    name = split(self.almt_path)[-1]
    return name.endswith('.amt') and name[:-4] in roster.BATTLE_IDS

populate_moves.original_source:
def populate_moves(self, keep=False, select=None):
    t = self.moves_tree
    cur = self.almt.moves.index(self.move) if keep and self.move in (self.almt.moves if self.almt else []) else select
    t.delete(*t.get_children())
    if not self.almt:
        self.move = None
        self.refresh_animation()
        return
    flt = self.move_filter.get().strip().lower()
    for i, m in enumerate(self.almt.moves):
        control = self._move_control_and_title(m)
        if flt and flt not in str(i) and flt not in hx(m.id).lower() and flt not in control.lower():
            continue
        t.insert('', 'end', str(i), values=(i, hx(m.id, 6), m.duration, '⟳' if m.flags & 1 else '', control))
    target = str(cur if cur is not None else 0)
    if t.exists(target):
        t.selection_set(target)
        t.focus(target)
        t.see(target)
    elif not keep:
        self.move = None
    self.on_move_select()

on_move_select.original_source:
def on_move_select(self, _e=None):
    # Roster owns move selection. Its old Moves Treeview remains an internal
    # model for Undo/Timeline but is hidden; queued Tk selection events from
    # that hidden widget must not trigger another expensive redraw.
    if (_e is not None and hasattr(self, '_animation_clips') and
            not self._animation_clips.winfo_ismapped()):
        return
    sel = self.moves_tree.focus()
    new = self.almt.moves[int(sel)] if self.almt and sel else None
    changed = new is not self.move
    if changed:
        self._stop_play()
        self._need_frame = True
        self.sel_track = self.sel_key = self.sel_virtual = None
    self.move = new
    if changed:
        self.after(5, self.fit_timeline)
    self._refresh_pursuer_links()
    self.tick = min(self.tick, self.move.duration) if self.move else 0
    if _e is not None:
        self.tick = 0
    self.refresh_animation()
    self.after(10, self.frame_view_if_needed)

duplicate_move.original_source:
def duplicate_move(self):
    if not self.move:
        return
    self.checkpoint('duplicate move')
    d = almt.move_to_dict(self.move, self.almt.node_names)
    new = almt.move_from_dict(d, self.almt.node_names)
    new.id = max(m.id for m in self.almt.moves) + 1
    self.almt.moves.append(new)
    self.mark_almt()
    self.move_filter.set('')
    self.populate_moves(select=len(self.almt.moves) - 1)
    self.status.set(f'Duplicated move as {hx(new.id)}')

populate_archive.original_source:
def populate_archive(self):
    t = self.member_tree
    t.delete(*t.get_children())
    if not self.container:
        return
    arc = self.root_data.archive(self.container)
    self.archive_info.configure(text=f'{split(self.container)[-1]}   ALAR v{arc.version} · flags '
                                     f'{hx(arc.flags, 2)} · {len(arc.entries)} members')
    kinds = {b'ALMT': 'ALMT', b'DSTX': 'DSTX', b'DSIG': 'DSIG', b'ALOD': 'ALOD', b'ALAR': 'ALAR',
             b'ALTM': 'ALTM'}
    for k, e in enumerate(arc.entries):
        payload_kind = 'packed' if e.compressed else kinds.get(e.data[:4], 'data')
        ok = '' if e.name_hash is None else ('✓' if arc.expected_hash(e) == e.name_hash else '✗')
        t.insert('', 'end', str(k), values=(e.name, payload_kind, hx(e.id), hx(e.attributes),
                                            f'{(e.name_hash or 0):04X} {ok}', len(e.data),
                                            'yes' if e.compressed else ''))
    self._member_details()

rebuild_check.original_source:
def rebuild_check(self):
    if not self.container:
        return
    arc = self.root_data.archive(self.container)
    built = arc.build()
    again = alar.Archive.parse(built)
    same = [a.data == b.data for a, b in zip(arc.entries, again.entries)]
    messagebox.showinfo('Rebuild check', f'Rebuilt {len(built):,} bytes; {sum(same)}/{len(same)} members '
                                         're-read identically.')
